No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you trace historic gates, print culture and street morphology.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Delhi Gate public-viewing orientation
  • Street plan and surviving facades
  • Publishing and reading culture stories
  • Neighbourhood memory mapping

How the time is spent

  1. Delhi Gate public-viewing orientation 20 min

  2. Street plan and surviving facades 40 min

  3. Publishing and reading culture stories 40 min

  4. Neighbourhood memory mapping 20 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify Delhi Gate from public viewpoints and explain its place among the historic gates.
  • Read the street plan and surviving facades of Daryaganj as evidence of how the area developed.
  • Relate stories of publishing and reading culture to places, and map neighbourhood memories.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
